acceptance.given: The Replay Matrix has an independently malformed package fixture for the invalid-package case and both Stable and Candidate subjects are bound.

oracle.expected: Machine-verifiable evidence records separate Stable and Candidate observations, each rejecting the package for its intended defect.
forbidden: The invalid-package case is omitted or executes fewer than both subjects.
A package not independently malformed for its intended defect is accepted as the invalid-package case.
oracle.observable: The S7 test evidence contains two subject-specific observations with intended-defect rejection and distinct execution bindings.

acceptance.then: The invalid-package Matrix Case is accepted only when both subject observations independently reject the intended defect.
acceptance.when: During Replay Matrix execution, run the invalid-package case for Stable and Candidate and inspect their machine-verifiable result bindings.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the invalid-package Matrix Case with both Stable and Candidate; fail if either subject is missing, shares copied evidence, or does not reject the independently malformed package.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Execute both Stable and Candidate against an independently malformed invalid-package fixture and emit separate intended-defect rejection observations.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay result and matrix evidence schemas; invalid-package execution remains append-only and non-authorizing.

slice_hint.state_transition: Invalid-package Matrix Case transitions from unverified to two-sided intended-defect rejection evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The case is terminal-success only when Stable and Candidate each have independent, bound observations rejecting the intended defect; otherwise it fails.

acceptance.given: A Replay Matrix contains multiple Matrix Cases, each with a frozen expectation and separate observation storage.

oracle.expected: For every Matrix Case, the evidence records its own frozen expectation and separate Stable/Candidate observations without cross-case reuse.
forbidden: A Matrix Case executes without its own frozen expectation.
oracle.observable: The S7 validation artifact maps each Matrix Case to a unique expectation record and case-owned observations.

acceptance.then: The matrix ownership check passes only when every case has an independent expectation and observation set.
acceptance.when: During matrix preparation and evaluation, inspect the serialized case records and verify ownership boundaries before aggregate evaluation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Validate matrix records for one expectation and separate observations per case; fail on shared observation identifiers, missing expectations, or cross-case evidence references.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce case-owned frozen expectations and separate observations as a structural matrix boundary before aggregate evaluation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing matrix record format while rejecting shared or missing case-owned evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix Case records transition from unvalidated ownership to structurally verified case-local expectations and observations.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every Matrix Case has exactly one frozen expectation and non-shared observations; any violation yields a failed structural check.

acceptance.given: A pinned source result contains a terminal semantic verdict, and the replay process can reconstruct the original binding identity before execution.

oracle.expected: Machine-verifiable fresh replay evidence reports a terminal semantic verdict equal to the pinned verdict under the same reconstructed binding identity.
forbidden: The fresh replay produces a different terminal verdict while being reported as reproduced.
oracle.observable: The S7 replay receipt contains reconstructed binding identity, fresh execution evidence, and an equality check between pinned and replayed terminal verdicts.

acceptance.then: Replay reproduction is accepted only when the fresh terminal verdict equals the pinned terminal verdict and the binding identity is unchanged.
acceptance.when: After reconstructing the original binding identity, execute a fresh replay and compare its terminal verdict with the pinned source result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Reconstruct the original binding identity, run fresh replay with that identity, and fail when the terminal semantic verdict differs or equality is asserted without machine evidence.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Rebuild the original binding identity before fresh replay and compare terminal semantic verdicts using machine-verifiable evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve replay receipt compatibility while adding explicit identity reconstruction and terminal-verdict equality evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Fresh replay transitions from pinned-result-only state to reproduced or mismatch terminal state with bound identity evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Terminal reproduction succeeds only when reconstructed identity matches the original and fresh replay verdict equals the pinned verdict; otherwise it fails closed.

acceptance.given: Pinned inputs and their coverage result are available for evaluation from a fresh checkout.

oracle.expected: The fresh-checkout evaluation produces the same coverage result as the pinned-input evaluation.
forbidden: A coverage result that differs from the result produced from the pinned inputs.
oracle.observable: The S24 test evidence records pinned-input and fresh-checkout coverage results with a machine-verifiable equality comparison.

acceptance.then: Reproducibility is accepted only when fresh-checkout coverage equals the pinned-input coverage result.
acceptance.when: Evaluate the pinned inputs in a fresh checkout and compare the resulting coverage to the pinned-input result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the fresh-checkout pinned-input evaluation and fail when its coverage result differs from the pinned-input coverage result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Evaluate pinned inputs from a fresh checkout and emit a machine-verifiable coverage equality comparison.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve pinned-input evaluation semantics and mark prior evidence stale when bound inputs differ.

slice_hint.state_transition: Coverage evaluation transitions from pinned-input result to fresh-checkout reproduction or mismatch failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Reproduction succeeds only when fresh-checkout coverage equals pinned-input coverage under unchanged bound inputs; mismatch fails closed.
